If you’re single this holiday season, you’re probably dreading the questions coming your way from family members and friends: Are you seeing anyone? Why haven’t you found a partner? 

While well-intentioned, these questions often leave you feeling depleted and irritated. But what if we looked at love differently and extended it beyond traditional partnerships? Soul Searching columnist Casper ter Kuile explores what religion teaches us about love, and how we can apply it to our everyday lives. 

Read more: https://www.vox.com/advice/510520/single-life-nun-advice
